usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.images.variations.create(image: StringIO.new("Example data"), model: "string", n: 1, response_format: "url", size: "256x256", user: "string")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.images.variations.create(image:, model: nil, n: nil, response_format: nil, size: nil, user: nil) -> Models::ImagesResponse

fields.name: image
fields.description: The image to use as the basis for the variation(s). Must be a valid PNG file, less than 4MB, and square.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model to use for image generation. Only `dall-e-2` is supported at this time.

fields.name: n
fields.description: The number of images to generate. Must be between 1 and 10.

fields.name: response_format
fields.description: The format in which the generated images are returned. Must be one of `url` or `b64_json`. URLs are only valid for 60 minutes after the image has been generated.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The size of the generated images. Must be one of `256x256`, `512x512`, or `1024x1024`.

fields.name: user
fields.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse. [Learn more](/docs/guides/safety-best-practices#end-user-ids).

fields.name: created
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the image was created.

fields.name: background
fields.description: The background parameter used for the image generation. Either `transparent` or `opaque`.

fields.name: output_format
fields.description: The output format of the image generation. Either `png`, `webp`, or `jpeg`.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The size of the image generated. Either `1024x1024`, `1024x1536`, or `1536x1024`.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: The quality of the image generated. Either `low`, `medium`, or `high`.
